product_js.title: Custom Trucking Semi Truck Breaking Through Stone Wall Vintage Comforter
product_js.description:
Add a bold, personalized touch to your bedroom with this custom trucking-themed comforter set from Jeminise, designed specifically for truckers and truck enthusiasts.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize this bedding set with your own name or custom text for a truly unique look.
  • Factual Visual Motif: Features a striking digital illustration of a semi truck breaking through a stone wall on a cracked surface.
  • Premium Comfort: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping.
  • Versatile Options: Available as either a Duvet Cover (no filling) or a Comforter (with filling), with optional matching pillowcases.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in standard US Twin, Full, Queen, and King sizes to fit your bed perfectly.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; tumble dry on low heat for quick, fluffy results.

product_js.title: Custom Trucking Semi Truck Centered on Chevron Background Comforter
product_js.description:
Transform your bedroom with this custom-designed comforter set from Jeminise, perfect for truckers and truck enthusiasts alike. Featuring a bold design tailored to the trucker lifestyle, this high-quality bedding adds a modern, personal touch to any space, making it a thoughtful gift for family, friends, or yourself.

Key Features

  • Customizable Design: Personalization options are supported with custom text input to create a truly unique bedding piece.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to ensure a lightweight, comfortable, and durable sleep experience.
  • Vibrant & Durable: Advanced digital printing methods keep the colors vivid and prevent fading, with fine, compact stitching along the edges for lasting durability.
  • Complete Set Options: Available as a duvet cover or comforter set with optional matching pillowcases and flat sheets to suit your needs.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; air dry or tumble dry on low heat to keep the microfiber fluffy and soft.

live.meta_description: Shop the custom semi truck comforter set. Features a starry night sky design, personalized name input, and soft brushed polyester fabric.

product_js.title: Custom Trucking Semi Truck Under Starry Night Sky Comforter
product_js.description:
Transform your bedroom with the Custom Trucker Bedding Set, brought to you by Jeminise. This modern comforter set is designed specifically for trucking enthusiasts, featuring a striking graphic illustration of a semi-truck under a starry night sky. Perfect as a cozy addition to your bed or as a thoughtful, personalized gift for family and friends, this bedding set allows you to enter a custom name to make it truly unique.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize this trucker bedding with your own text input, such as a name, to create a one-of-a-kind look.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Available Sizes: Choose from standard US bedding sizes including Twin (68" x 88"), Full (78" x 88"), Queen (88" x 88"), and King (104" x 88").
  • Included Components: Features one duvet cover or comforter, with the option to add matching pillowcases or a flat sheet.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; air dry without heat or tumble dry on low heat for quick fluffing.
  • Superior Craftsmanship: Smooth, fine, and compact stitching along the edges ensures long-lasting durability and color vibrancy.

Product Specifications

Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Fill Material Microfiber
Selected Design Love Trucker
Theme Trucker
Pattern Cartoon
Style Modern
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
